control_flow: driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, curve with wheels 40 % and 20 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left with wheels 10 % and 40 %; else curve right with wheels 40 % and 10 %.
On a plain bright floor it curves to the right, because followLine sees no black.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, drive straight through a dark tunnel without touching its walls, and follow the line again after the tunnel.
